# DirectXMod (gl4dx12)

> **Native D3D12 rendering backend for Minecraft 26.2 Fabric Mod.**
> By implementing Minecraft's official `GpuBackend` / `GpuDeviceBackend` interfaces, replace the OpenGL/Vulkan rendering path with a C++ native DLL (`dx12_mc.dll`), allowing Minecraft to use D3D12 to directly render the game screen, while retaining Mod extension points (AA settings, ModMenu integration).

## Notes
> This mod cannot possibly change the vast ecosystem of OpenGL/Vulkan (officially appointed), and will stop any updates other than version adaptation after reaching a stable state, and will open source using the CC0 protocol.

> Credits: 爱睡觉的白洲梓 / xiaozi Graphics Development Team

## Overview

This project uses **Mixin injection** to modify Minecraft's graphics API selection logic, allowing the game to use D3D12 backend rendering, while providing rendering state synchronization, configuration management, and Mod compatibility layer through the Java layer.

### Core Features

- **Mixin Injection**: 12 Mixins cover graphics API selection + initialization/rendering/resource loading/world loading/chunks/camera/fog full-chain diagnosis (see [Mixin Injection Points](#mixin-注入点))
- **Official GpuBackend Interface**: Complete implementation of `GpuBackend` / `GpuDeviceBackend` / `CommandEncoderBackend` / `RenderPassBackend` / `GpuSurfaceBackend` and other official interfaces
- **Zero Custom Render Loop**: Does not override `RenderSystem`, completely takes over Minecraft's official rendering process
- **Shaderc + Spvc Compilation Chain**: GLSL → SPIR-V (shaderc) → HLSL SM5.1 (spvc) → DXBC (D3DCompile)
- **Resource Safety**: All D3D12 resources are managed through Java wrapper classes (`Dx12Gpu*`), automatically released following Minecraft's lifecycle
- **Configuration Interface**: Fx12Config persistent configuration, Dx12SettingsScreen settings interface, ModMenu integration
- **DLL Auto-loading**: Extract from JAR to `{user.dir}/dx12mod/dx12_mc.dll`, supports version isolation
- **MC 26.2**: Supports Mojang official mappings (does not depend on Yarn mappings), fabric-api 0.156.0+26.2 / loader 0.19.3 / ModMenu 20.0.1

Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: Public repository of data on scheduled power outages in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

Public repository and tools for automatic collection, parsing, visualization (HTML) and automatic generation of PNG images of charts of scheduled/emergency power outages in Ukraine.

The project receives data from open web pages of suppliers and stores it in JSON 'as is' in the `data/` directory. Next, these data are displayed in a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are stored in `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data Format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for a week for each group (weekly template). Stored 'as is', without normalization of structure.
- `fact` — actual/emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

SummerXaa-Z/tokenmeter-mac.body:
# TokenMeter

> Originally named DeepSeek Monitor for macOS, renamed starting from v3.0.

TokenMeter is a persistent macOS menu bar AI usage monitoring application: unified view of AI Coding Token, costs, quotas, trends, and local personal profiles for Claude, Codex, Kimi Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen Code, and Cursor, and displays DeepSeek platform API consumption and balance as a separate account dimension. Click the menu bar icon, and the panel drops down as a native NSPopover next to the icon.

The current main version is **native Swift implementation** (SwiftUI + AppKit), and the earlier Tauri 2 + React + Rust version (v1.1.0) is preserved in the `tauri-version` branch.

Disclaimer: This project is not an official DeepSeek product.

## Installation

Download the latest `TokenMeter_<version>_aarch64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) from [Releases](https://github.com/SummerXaa-Z/tokenmeter-mac/blob/HEAD/../../releases), open the dmg and drag `TokenMeter.app` into Applications.

### First Launch Shows "Cannot Open" "Cannot Verify Developer"

This project is an open-source self-signed application **without Apple's paid notarization**, so it will be blocked by Gatekeeper when first opened after downloading. This is not a virus, but macOS's standard blocking of non-notarized applications. Choose either option to bypass (only need to do once):

- **Method 1 (Recommended, a few clicks)**: In Applications, **right-click TokenMeter → Open**, then click "Open" again in the dialog. After that, double-clicking works normally.
- **Method 2 (One command)**: Execute in Terminal to clear the download quarantine mark:

  ```bash
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/TokenMeter.app
  ```

> To completely avoid this prompt, you need Apple Developer ID signing + notarization ($99/year). As a free open-source tool, this project hasn't done so yet and will be decided based on circumstances. The code is fully open-source; if concerned, you can clone and build it yourself (see "Build and Run" below).

This project is derived from a macOS port of someone else's open-source work, with the source chain as follows:

> [!TIP]

>
> Website: **[wallpapermachine.app](https://www.wallpapermachine.app/)** · GitHub: **[WallpaperMachine/WallpaperMachine](https://github.com/WallpaperMachine/WallpaperMachine)**

A macOS WeChat 4 tool for regular users: retain recalled messages, also supports custom notifications, multiple WeChat instances, block automatic updates, and one-click restore.

**[Download Latest Version](https://github.com/fzlzjerry/wechat-antirecall/releases)** · [Troubleshooting](#遇到问题) · [Advanced Usage](#进阶用户命令行)

>
> - Currently only supports **Apple Silicon (M-series) Mac**.
> - Please **completely quit WeChat** before installing.
> - The tool modifies the WeChat App, but automatically keeps a backup each time, which can be restored anytime.

---

| Avoid patches being overwritten after WeChat auto-upgrades | **Block Automatic Updates** |
| Log in to multiple WeChat accounts simultaneously | **Multiple WeChat Instances** |
| Automatically collect newly received regular red packets | **Auto Red Packets (269624 / 269628 / 270090 / 270100)** |
| Return to the original WeChat before modifications | **Restore / Uninstall** |

Regular users only need to use the graphical interface, no need to open the terminal, and no need to understand patch addresses or build parameters.

nasa-runtime/nasa-runtime-rust.body:
# nasa-runtime-rust

NASA Rust shared library is a set of infrastructure packages combined by features.
**The sole entry point for businesses is the facade package `nasa`**: business projects only depend on `nasa`, then optionally enable features such as Saga, mapping, transactions, caching, Redis, RedisJob, cross-replica business quota, WebSocket, configuration, service discovery, etc.
The remaining members are used for implementation and macro expansion; business projects are not recommended to directly depend on them by default.
Application simultaneously provides a business initialization barrier before Ready and ordered asynchronous cleanup before business resources are closed; business does not need to separately set up signal handling or shutdown callback collections.
Redis partitioned consumption separates persistent takeover from local execution: different Redis sources always use independent Runners, same source can be divided by `source`, `group`, `stream` for scheduling and capacity; business key order overrides handler, ACK and precise retry.
Reliable Saga client places business facts and initiation intent in the same database transaction, and lets the dispatcher consistently scan that transaction domain; when the remote is unavailable or receipt is lost, original events are retained, explicit data source conflicts are rejected before Ready.
Mapper simultaneously provides default collected SQL metrics, distinguishing logical methods, actual database execution, connection waiting and stream consumption; business develops SQL/parameter output, slow operation and error notification and metrics export through the same YAML configuration, notification failures do not affect business transactions.
Slow SQL is based on the original execution time reaching or exceeding the configured threshold; after the business installs `Notify`, enables alerting and disables notification cooldown, each hit attempts to enter a bounded notification queue, and the sending protocol and independent notification microservice are implemented by the business.

> Name Declaration: This project is an independent open-source project with no affiliation, sponsorship, endorsement or official project relationship with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration of the United States, and does not use its badges, logos, seals or other official visual identifiers. See [NOTICE](https://github.com/nasa-runtime/nasa-runtime-rust/blob/HEAD/NOTICE) for the complete declaration.

Application standard manages Redis Stream/Proxy/AutoPipeline, outbound TCP frame client, hystrix command directory, Mapper cache, named idempotency and audit, REST, object storage, Schema Registry, secret/TLS and local file monitoring. Business submits configuration and handler, the framework completes resource assembly before receiving traffic, unified management of health, configuration application status and shutdown; no need to separately build connection pools, monitoring loops or shutdown tasks for these capabilities. The entry points and boundaries of each capability see [Managed Capabilities Contract](https://github.com/nasa-runtime/nasa-runtime-rust/blob/HEAD/docs/managed-capabilities.md).

rehiy/isrvd.body:
# iSrvd

> The name derives from *"it is a server daemon"*, `srv` corresponds to the Linux conventional directory `/srv`, `d` represents daemon. **Pronunciation**: pronounced as **"I served"** (/ˈaɪ sɜːrvd/), a homophone for "love service".

A lightweight operations dashboard built with Go + Vue 3, integrating file management, Docker container orchestration, APISIX/Caddy gateway configuration, Web terminal, GPU monitoring, scheduled tasks, and AI assistant, providing one-stop management experience for personal servers and small-to-medium teams.

## Features

| Module | Features |
| ------ | ------ |
| System Overview | CPU, memory, disk, network, Go runtime and GPU monitoring, supporting historical data collection, service availability detection, and online upgrades |
| File Management | Browse, upload, download, edit, create/delete directories, rename, permission modification, compress/decompress |
| Web Terminal | Shell terminal based on xterm.js, supporting container terminal access |
| Local Processes | View host process list (CPU, memory, command line), terminate specified processes (founders only, mandatory audit) |
| SSH Remote Management | Manage hosts and reusable credentials, supporting password/private key authentication, browser terminal, and SFTP file management |
| AI Assistant | Built-in Copilot based on CopilotKit + AG-UI protocol, calling backend interfaces through built-in OpenAPI directory, supporting page context, tool cards, and write operation approval, compatible with OpenAI API LLM integration |
| Scheduled Tasks | Scheduled task scheduling; providing Shell or BAT/PowerShell scripts and executable file tasks based on running platform, also supporting temporary container or existing container execution when Docker is available |
| APISIX | Route, Consumer, Upstream, SSL certificate, plugin configuration (PluginConfig), plugin list, access authorization management |
| Caddy | HTTP service, routing, Basic Auth, SSL certificate, global options management, supporting raw configuration editing |
